title: [HIRING] Looking for a Video Host/On-camera presenter (Product Demo Walkthrough)
description:
We're a B2B SaaS brand looking for product video presenters.

I'm looking for a very specific presentation style, so please read this through before applying.

Imagine a product demo is playing while the screen is being shared, and you're simply explaining what's happening. That's exactly the kind of video we're creating with the camera chaging between your presentation and the product screen.

I'm not looking for someone who's overly animated, overly expressive, or has a typical YouTube-style presentation. At the same time, I don't want the delivery to feel dead or completely flat either.

What I'm looking for is someone who feels natural, casual and straightforward. Think of an IT professional explaining a product to another IT professional. Our audience is mainly IT managers and similar technical buyers, so I just want a relatable face that talks like one of them.

Prior experience presenting product demos, SaaS walkthroughs or training videos is a plus, but it's absolutely not mandatory. The one thing I'm looking for above everything else is how you present. If your presentation style matches what I'm after, that's far more important than your previous experience.

We'll start with a single video that's around 3-4 minutes long. The budget for this first video is 75-100$. If it's a good fit, I'm planning to do quite a few more.

We'll provide the script and the product demo. I'm not looking for any video editing from your side—you just need to record yourself presenting it. All I ask is that you have a space that feels like a natural workspace: clean, uncluttered and aesthetically pleasing. Good lighting and clear audio are important too.

When you apply, please keep it simple:

Send no more than two samples, and please make them the ones that are closest to the style described above. I'd much rather watch two relevant samples than ten unrelated ones.

Include your rate for a 3–4 minute video.

If you've read this entire post, please include the word hockey in the your answer. It'll help me filter out people who are mass-applying without reading the brief.

References

I'm attaching two references so you have the exact idea of the presentation style I'm looking for.

Reference 1 (closest to what I'm looking for):https://www.instagram.com/p/DYpsBRPDGHn/?igsh=Y21rMWQ4Ym9nbnVw

Reference 2:https://www.instagram.com/p/DYpsBUvDHHR/?igsh=eWZlc3A0NmNhaHFs

Reference 2 is just a little flatter than what I have in mind, but it's still fairly close. Overall, I'm looking for something that sits somewhere around these two.

Preferred location: US-based presenters.

I've been on the other side of hiring before, so I'll genuinely try my best to give everyone a response.

Link to apply: https://forms.gle/pwBDt6ARJFJp5zvn8

Don't DM me please or start a new chat, those won't be considered. Apply through the form.
